items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Later on, I played in segregated places with Lionel Hampton’s band

ctx.x: No, not really. Anyone could come into the dance. Later on, I played in segregated places with Lionel Hampton’s band where one night was for white and one night for colored. Or else there was a rope going down the dance hall, but in this case, it wasn’t like that. Segregation was in the schools and the theaters and the churches.
So, Lunceford’s band came through, Artie Shaw’s band…
